title: Massachusetts fair housing source-of-income protection
requirement: A landlord or any person furnishing rental accommodations may not discriminate against a tenant because the tenant receives federal, state, or local public assistance or housing subsidies, including rental assistance or rental supplements.
coverage_conditions: Any person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations; protects tenants who receive federal, state or local public assistance or housing subsidies.
quoted_span: For any person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations to discriminate against any individual who is a recipient of federal, state, or local public assistance, including medical assistance, or who is a tenant receiving federal, state, or local housing subsidies, including rental assistance or rental supplements, because the individual is such a recipient
